## Hello

I'm Madhusudan, an applied statistician. I trained as a computer science
engineer and moved into statistics through the work itself: first randomised evaluations,
then causal inference on observational data, and now methodology for official statistics.

BetterCallStats is where I write down what I've learned, mostly so that I understand it
properly. If I can't explain a method from the assumptions up, with code that runs, I
don't really know it yet.

## What I work on

- **Causal inference.** Experiments and what to do when you can't run one: matching,
  difference-in-differences, DAGs and survival models.
- **Spatial statistics.** Spatial regression and modelling data where location matters.
- **Survey and official statistics.** Editing and imputation, missing data, and how to
  measure whether a method is doing its job.
- **Bayesian modelling.** Mostly PyMC and brms.
- **Tools.** Python, R and SQL, with a preference for code that can be tested.

## What to expect here

- Posts that start from a question, state their assumptions, and show the maths.
- Code you can read in full. Small examples run in your browser, so you can change a
  number and see what happens.
- Series, not one-offs. The first is on causal inference, starting with
  [Alphabets of Causality](../posts/alphabets_causality/index.qmd).
- Book and paper recommendations along the way.

## Get in touch

Spotted a mistake, or disagree with something? I'd like to hear it. Message me on
[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/madhusudan-chunletia-83a623210) or open an issue on the
[blog's repository](https://github.com/Bettercallstats/blog/issues).
